AI_AGENTS.DESCRIPTION: This is the page where you can revisit the AI agents you created earlier. Feel free to make changes and create as many AI agents as you want anytime!
AI_AGENTS.NO_RESULTS: No AI agents match your search.

CREATE.TITLE: Create AI agent
CREATE.DESCRIPTION: Give your AI agent a name. You can set up its behavior and settings next.
CREATE.ERROR: Could not create the AI agent. Please try again.

DUPLICATE.ERROR: Could not duplicate the AI agent. Please try again.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete {name}?
DELETE.DESCRIPTION: This permanently removes the AI agent and its settings. This cannot be undone.
DELETE.ERROR: Could not delete the AI agent. Please try again.

DETAIL.NOT_FOUND: This AI agent does not exist or was deleted.

BEHAVIOR.TITLE: AI Agent Behavior
BEHAVIOR.DESCRIPTION: This is the AI Prompt that defines the AI's speaking style and identity.
BEHAVIOR.PLACEHOLDER: e.g. You are the customer service of our store. Answer briefly and kindly.

WELCOME_MESSAGE.TITLE: Welcome Message
WELCOME_MESSAGE.DESCRIPTION: The first message the AI will send to the user.
WELCOME_MESSAGE.PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Hi! I am the virtual assistant. How can I help you today?

TRANSFER_CONDITIONS.TITLE: Agent Transfer Conditions
TRANSFER_CONDITIONS.DESCRIPTION: Define conditions that trigger the AI to transfer the chat to a human agent. The chat leaves the AI, becomes Open, and appears in the Assigned or Unassigned tab.
TRANSFER_CONDITIONS.PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Transfer when the customer asks to talk to a person or wants to complain.

STOP_AI_AFTER_HANDOFF.TITLE: Stop AI after Handoff
STOP_AI_AFTER_HANDOFF.DESCRIPTION: Stop the AI from replying once it hands the chat over to a human agent. When off, the AI keeps replying until a human agent replies.

SILENT_HANDOFF.TITLE: Silent Agent Handoff
SILENT_HANDOFF.DESCRIPTION: AI transfers the conversation to an agent without a transition message and sends no further messages.

BUSINESS_SCOPE.TITLE: Business Scope
BUSINESS_SCOPE.DESCRIPTION: Limit what the AI talks about to your business

MODE.TITLE: Scope Mode
MODE.DESCRIPTION: In Strict mode the AI checks each customer message against the business below before answering: messages outside it get the off-topic reply, unclear ones the clarification reply. Each answer is then checked against the knowledge it used before it is sent, and one the knowledge does not back gets the knowledge gap reply. When off, only the AI Agent Behavior limits it.

BUSINESS_DESCRIPTION.TITLE: Business Description
BUSINESS_DESCRIPTION.DESCRIPTION: What the business does. Required in Strict mode.
BUSINESS_DESCRIPTION.PLACEHOLDER: e.g. A bakery in Bandung that sells bread and cakes, including custom cakes and delivery.

ALLOWED_TOPICS.TITLE: Allowed Topics
ALLOWED_TOPICS.DESCRIPTION: What customers can ask about. Required in Strict mode.
ALLOWED_TOPICS.PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Products and prices, stock, opening hours, location, orders, payment, delivery, order complaints

DISALLOWED_TOPICS.TITLE: Disallowed Topics
DISALLOWED_TOPICS.DESCRIPTION: Topics the AI must refuse, even when they seem related to the business. Optional.
DISALLOWED_TOPICS.PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Politics, sports, entertainment, general knowledge, homework, programming, personal chat

OFF_TOPIC_MESSAGE.TITLE: Off-topic Reply
OFF_TOPIC_MESSAGE.DESCRIPTION: Sent as is when a message is outside the business or tries to change the AI's rules. Required in Strict mode.
OFF_TOPIC_MESSAGE.PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Sorry, I can only help with questions about our bakery: products, orders, and delivery.

CLARIFICATION_MESSAGE.TITLE: Clarification Reply
CLARIFICATION_MESSAGE.DESCRIPTION: Sent as is when a message does not say which product or order it means. Required in Strict mode.
CLARIFICATION_MESSAGE.PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Could you tell me which product or order you mean?

KNOWLEDGE_GAP_MESSAGE.TITLE: Knowledge Gap Reply
KNOWLEDGE_GAP_MESSAGE.DESCRIPTION: Sent as is when the knowledge has no answer to a question, or when an answer cites no knowledge or has a number that neither its knowledge nor the conversation has. Required in Strict mode.
KNOWLEDGE_GAP_MESSAGE.PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Sorry, we don't have that information yet. Is there anything else we can help with?

WEB_SEARCH.TITLE: Web Search
WEB_SEARCH.DESCRIPTION: When a message asks for general information within the allowed topics, such as symptoms, maintenance, or recalls, the AI searches the web with a query it writes without personal data, and adds the links of the results it uses to its reply. Business facts still come only from the knowledge, and contact requests are never searched. Needs a web search provider and its API key in Super Admin.

WEB_SEARCH_DOMAINS.TITLE: Web Search Domains
WEB_SEARCH_DOMAINS.DESCRIPTION: Only search these websites, separated by commas or line breaks. Optional; leave empty to search the whole web.

PENDING_MESSAGES.TITLE: Pending status messages
PENDING_MESSAGES.DESCRIPTION: Set messages customers receive while they wait for a human agent after a handoff

ASSIGNED.TITLE: Pending - assigned message
ASSIGNED.DESCRIPTION: Sent once per handoff when the customer writes and an agent is already assigned. Requires Stop AI after Handoff on and Silent Agent Handoff off.
ASSIGNED.PLACEHOLDER: Enter message for pending assigned conversations

UNASSIGNED.TITLE: Pending - unassigned message
UNASSIGNED.DESCRIPTION: Sent once per handoff when the customer writes and no agent is assigned yet. Requires Stop AI after Handoff on and Silent Agent Handoff off.
UNASSIGNED.PLACEHOLDER: Enter message for pending unassigned conversations

AI_ACTIONS.TITLE: AI Actions
AI_ACTIONS.DESCRIPTION: Configure labels that AI can use automatically

LABELS.TITLE: Change Conversation Label
LABELS.DESCRIPTION: Select labels that AI is allowed to use for tagging conversations automatically.

LABEL_CONDITIONS.TITLE: Label Conditions
LABEL_CONDITIONS.DESCRIPTION: Instructions for when AI should apply specific labels. Example: "Apply label Purchased when customer confirms a purchase"
LABEL_CONDITIONS.PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Apply label booking when the customer has filled in the order format.

ADDITIONAL_SETTINGS.TITLE: Additional Settings
ADDITIONAL_SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Fine-tune memory, timing, and limits of the AI

HISTORY_LIMIT.TITLE: AI History Limit
HISTORY_LIMIT.DESCRIPTION: The number of messages the AI will remember.

READ_FILE_LIMIT.TITLE: AI Read File Limit
READ_FILE_LIMIT.DESCRIPTION: The number of recent messages whose file attachments the AI will read.

CONTEXT_LIMIT.TITLE: AI Context Limit
CONTEXT_LIMIT.DESCRIPTION: The number of knowledge entries sent to the AI with each reply. Increase this if replies to questions about several things at once leave some of them out.

CONTEXT_EXPANSION_RADIUS.TITLE: AI Context Expansion
CONTEXT_EXPANSION_RADIUS.DESCRIPTION: The number of knowledge chunks before and after each match, from the same part of the same document, sent with it. This helps when the answer continues in the next chunk. They count toward the AI Context Limit. Set 0 to send only the matches.

TEMPERATURE.TITLE: AI Temperature
TEMPERATURE.DESCRIPTION: The creativity level of the AI when responding to user messages.

MESSAGE_AWAIT.TITLE: Message Await
MESSAGE_AWAIT.DESCRIPTION: Delay time before the AI responds to a user message, in seconds.

MESSAGE_LIMIT.TITLE: AI Message Limit
MESSAGE_LIMIT.DESCRIPTION: Limit on the number of AI messages per conversation session. Resets when the chat is resolved.

WATCHER.TITLE: Watcher
WATCHER.DESCRIPTION: After each AI reply, runs an extra AI check that applies a handoff or label the reply missed.

TIMEZONE.TITLE: Timezone
TIMEZONE.DESCRIPTION: Select the timezone for the AI.

SESSION_ONLY_MEMORY.TITLE: Session-Only Memory
SESSION_ONLY_MEMORY.DESCRIPTION: When enabled, AI will start conversation without remembering previous session(s)

IGNORE_TEAM_HANDOFF.TITLE: Ignore Team Handoff
IGNORE_TEAM_HANDOFF.DESCRIPTION: Remove the conversation's team at handoff so any inbox agent can be assigned. When off, the team is kept and auto-assignment picks a team member.

GENERAL.SAVE_ERROR: Could not save the AI settings. Please try again.

CONNECTED_INBOXES.TITLE: Connected Inboxes
CONNECTED_INBOXES.DESCRIPTION: The AI agent replies to new and pending conversations in these inboxes. An inbox can be connected to one AI agent only.

TRAINING.TRAIN_SUCCESS: Training started. Knowledge changes are also trained automatically.
TRAINING.TRAIN_ERROR: Could not start training. Please try again.

GENERAL.LLM_NOT_CONFIGURED: The AI model API key is not configured, so this AI agent cannot reply or train its knowledge. Ask the installation administrator to add it in Super Admin.

PLAYGROUND.TITLE: Playground
PLAYGROUND.DESCRIPTION: Chat with this AI agent to test its replies. Saved settings and trained knowledge are used; nothing is sent to customers.
PLAYGROUND.ERROR: The AI agent could not reply. Please try again.

KNOWLEDGE.LOAD_ERROR: Could not load the knowledge. Please refresh the page.

TEXT.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Add a text with information your AI agent should know, such as your business profile, address, or opening hours.
TEXT.PLACEHOLDER: Write what your AI agent should know...
TEXT.SAVE_ERROR: Could not save the text knowledge. Please try again.
TEXT.CREATE_ERROR: Could not add the text. Please try again.
TEXT.RENAME_ERROR: Could not rename the text. Please try again.
TEXT.DELETE_DESCRIPTION: The AI agent will no longer use this text. This cannot be undone.
TEXT.DELETE_ERROR: Could not delete the text. Please try again.

QA.TITLE: Q&A
QA.DESCRIPTION: Add questions your customers often ask, together with the answer the AI agent should give.
QA.QUESTION: Question
QA.QUESTION_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. How long does exterior detailing take?
QA.ANSWER_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Exterior detailing takes about 4-5 hours.
QA.EMPTY: No Q&A yet. Add the first question your customers often ask.
QA.INCOMPLETE: Fill in both the question and the answer of every new or changed Q&A before saving.
QA.SAVE_ERROR: Could not save the Q&A. Please try again.
QA.DELETE_DESCRIPTION: The AI agent will no longer use this question and answer. This cannot be undone.
QA.DELETE_ERROR: Could not delete the Q&A. Please try again.

PRODUCT.TITLE: AI Product Knowledge
PRODUCT.DESCRIPTION: These products are part of your AI agent's knowledge base. The AI can provide information about them to your customers. Use the controls below to manage which products your AI knows about.
PRODUCT.EMPTY: No products yet. Add the products your AI agent should know about.
PRODUCT.DELETE_DESCRIPTION: The AI agent will no longer know about this product. This cannot be undone.
PRODUCT.BULK_DELETE_DESCRIPTION: The AI agent will no longer know about these products. This cannot be undone.
PRODUCT.DELETE_ERROR: Could not delete the products. Please try again.

FORM.NAME: Name
FORM.DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: What the product is and who it is for
FORM.IMAGE_HINT: JPG, PNG, GIF, or WebP up to 5 MB
FORM.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The image is larger than 5 MB. Choose a smaller image.
FORM.SAVE_ERROR: Could not save the product. Please try again.

WEBSITE.TITLE: Provide Link
WEBSITE.DESCRIPTION: Provide a link to the page you want the AI to learn from.
WEBSITE.COLLECT_HINT: Start with URL and this tool will gather up to 300 unique links from the site, excluding any files
WEBSITE.COLLECT_ERROR: Could not collect links from this site. Check the address and try again.
WEBSITE.ADD_SUCCESS: Links added. The AI agent will learn from them in a moment.
WEBSITE.ADD_ERROR: Could not add the links. Please try again.
WEBSITE.EMPTY: No links yet. Collect links from a site or add a single link above.
WEBSITE.RESYNC_ERROR: Could not start the sync. Please try again.
WEBSITE.DELETE_DESCRIPTION: The AI agent will no longer use these pages. This cannot be undone.
WEBSITE.DELETE_ERROR: Could not delete the links. Please try again.

FILE.TITLE: Files
FILE.DROPZONE: Drag & drop your files here or click to select files
FILE.SUPPORTED: Supported file types: PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT, MD (up to 100 MB each)
FILE.PDF_NOTE: If you are uploading a PDF, make sure you can highlight the text
FILE.UNSUPPORTED: {name} is not a supported file type.
FILE.UPLOAD_SUCCESS: Files uploaded. The AI agent will learn from them in a moment.
FILE.DELETE_DESCRIPTION: The AI agent will no longer use this file. This cannot be undone.
FILE.DELETE_ERROR: Could not delete the file. Please try again.

CHUNKS.TITLE: Chunks of {title}
CHUNKS.DESCRIPTION: The pieces this source was split into. The AI agent searches these pieces and sends the most relevant ones to the model with each reply.
CHUNKS.LOAD_ERROR: Could not load the chunks. Please try again.
CHUNKS.EMPTY: This source has no chunks yet. Knowledge is indexed shortly after it is added or changed.
CHUNKS.UNSEARCHABLE: {count} chunk was embedded with another model and is not searched until the AI agent is trained with {model}. | {count} chunks were embedded with another model and are not searched until the AI agent is trained with {model}.

INDEX.NOT_INDEXED: Not indexed yet. The AI agent does not use this source until indexing finishes.
INDEX.OUTDATED: Changed after the last indexing. The AI agent uses the previous version until indexing finishes.
INDEX.OTHER_MODEL: {count} chunk was embedded with another model and is not searched until the AI agent is trained again. | {count} chunks were embedded with another model and are not searched until the AI agent is trained again.

KNOWLEDGE.TRAINING_ERROR: Knowledge indexing failed {time}: {error}. The AI agent answers with the knowledge indexed before. Check the AI settings in Super Admin, then train the AI agent again from the General tab.

RETRIEVAL_TEST.TITLE: Retrieval test
RETRIEVAL_TEST.DESCRIPTION: Type a customer question to see which knowledge the AI agent would send to the model for it, in the same order as a real reply. Nothing is sent to customers.
RETRIEVAL_TEST.LABEL: Customer question
RETRIEVAL_TEST.PLACEHOLDER: For example: What are your opening hours?
RETRIEVAL_TEST.HISTORY_PLACEHOLDER: One message per line, oldest first. Start the AI agent's replies with AI:
RETRIEVAL_TEST.ERROR: Could not test the retrieval. Please try again.
RETRIEVAL_TEST.MODE_HYBRID: Searched by meaning with {model} and by keywords, then combined. The score is the combined rank: higher is closer.
RETRIEVAL_TEST.MODE_KEYWORD: Searched by keywords. The score is the rank in the keyword match: higher is closer.
RETRIEVAL_TEST.LIMIT: Up to {count} chunks are sent with a reply (Context Limit).
RETRIEVAL_TEST.EXPANSION: Each match brings up to {count} chunks before and after it from the same part of its document (Context Expansion), within that limit. Chunks of one part are shown in document order.
RETRIEVAL_TEST.NO_RESULTS: No knowledge was found. The AI agent would answer this question without knowledge.
RETRIEVAL_TEST.WEB_QUERY_PLACEHOLDER: For example: causes of an overheating car engine
RETRIEVAL_TEST.WEB_QUERY_HELP: Searched on the internet with the web search provider set in Super Admin, exactly as written. Name only the subject, without names, phone numbers, or other personal data. Each search counts against the monthly web search budget, except the same search again within 6 hours.

WEB.TITLE: Web results
WEB.NO_RESULTS: The web search found nothing for this query.

STATUS.SEARCHED: Searched the web in {latency} ms for {cost}.
STATUS.CACHED: Taken from the same search in the last 6 hours, at no cost.
STATUS.SKIPPED_BUDGET: Not searched: the monthly web search budget is used up, or the web search provider ran out of credits this month (UTC).
STATUS.FAILED_TIMEOUT: The web search provider did not answer in time. A reply would go on with the knowledge only.
STATUS.FAILED_RATE_LIMIT: The web search provider refused the search because too many were made. Try again later.
STATUS.FAILED_CREDITS: The web search provider has no credits left, so the web is not searched until next month (UTC).
STATUS.FAILED_PROVIDER: The web search provider could not be reached or had an error. Try again later.
STATUS.FAILED_REQUEST: The web search provider rejected the request. Ask the installation administrator to check the web search provider and its API key in Super Admin.

INTEGRATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Connect tools that this AI agent uses during conversations.

GOOGLE_SHEETS.TITLE: Google Sheets
GOOGLE_SHEETS.DESCRIPTION: The AI agent adds a row to your spreadsheet, such as a booking or an order, when a conversation meets your condition.
GOOGLE_SHEETS.UNAVAILABLE: Google Sheets needs the Google OAuth client and Active Record encryption keys. Ask the installation administrator to configure them.
GOOGLE_SHEETS.NEEDS_RECONNECT: Google access was lost, for example because access was revoked or the spreadsheet was removed. The AI agent stops writing rows until you reconnect and check the sheet settings.
GOOGLE_SHEETS.CONNECT_ERROR: Could not connect Google Sheets. Please try again.
GOOGLE_SHEETS.LOAD_ERROR: Could not load the Google Sheets settings. Please try again.

SPREADSHEET.TITLE: Spreadsheet URL
SPREADSHEET.DESCRIPTION: Copy the address of the spreadsheet from your browser. The connected Google account needs edit access to it.

SHEET_NAME.TITLE: Sheet name
SHEET_NAME.DESCRIPTION: The tab that receives the rows. Its first row holds the column headers.

GOOGLE_SHEETS.TEST_SUCCESS: Connection works. The columns are shown below.
GOOGLE_SHEETS.TEST_ERROR: Could not read the sheet. Please check the URL and the sheet name.

COLUMNS.TITLE: Columns
COLUMNS.DESCRIPTION: The AI agent fills one value per column, taken from the conversation.
COLUMNS.EMPTY: Test the connection to read the columns from the header row.

WHEN_TO_WRITE.TITLE: When to write
WHEN_TO_WRITE.DESCRIPTION: Describe when the AI agent adds a row. It writes the same data only once per conversation.
WHEN_TO_WRITE.PLACEHOLDER: e.g. When the customer has sent their name, date, and time for the booking.

GOOGLE_SHEETS.SAVE_ERROR: Could not save the Google Sheets settings. Please try again.
GOOGLE_SHEETS.DISCONNECT_ERROR: Could not disconnect Google Sheets. Please try again.

DISCONNECT_DIALOG.TITLE: Disconnect Google Sheets?
DISCONNECT_DIALOG.DESCRIPTION: The AI agent stops writing rows, Google access is revoked, and the sheet settings are removed.
